items.label: Universal Compatibility
items.value: Voice universal remote-control for most vizio smart-TV D, V, M, P, Series, Compatible with 4K UHD Quantum FHD Quantum-Pro QLED Smart TVs. Replace the original remote control that came with your TV.

items.label: Quick Access Buttons
items.value: Vtinvan XRT270 voice smart-tv-remote for Vizio TV with 7 Shortcut buttons at the top of the remote, get fast access to your favorite free channels and apps like Sling, Netflix, Prime Video, Redbox, IHeart Radio and more.

items.label: Easy to Setup and Pair
items.value: This voice-replacement remote for vizio smart TV has the convenience of voice control, uses voice to find your favorite content, and is simple to pair and use. Voice control does not work with all vizio TVs but the remote functions with all vizio smart TVs. ( TIP: If you plan to use microphone search function, you have to unpair the original remote and add new remote. Press the MIC and MUTE buttons to begin pairing mode.)

items: Smaller Size, Bigger Purpose： Wear-resistant ABS shell. Longer transmission range (over 40 feet), more stable performance. Compact size with less and smoother buttons – only the necessary ones, extremely accurate and easier to press. Rounded back design for a more comfortable grip, ergonomic design.

items.label: What You Get
items.value: 1 Voice Remote for Vizio Smart-TV-Remote(2 AAA batteries not included) and our friendly customer service. Voice control does not fit for all vizio TVs but the remote functions for all vizio TVs. If you have any questions during the ordering process, please feel free to contact us.
